description: This Java source file defines the XYDataReader class, which provides functionality to read XY data points from a file, parse each line into Point3D objects, and store them in an XYData structure. It handles file existence checks, exception handling, and logs the range of X and Y values read.

classes.name: XYDataReader
classes.description: Provides static methods to read XY data from a file, parse and store points, and log data ranges.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Public static method that checks for file existence, and initiates reading of XY data from the specified file.

methods.name: doReadFile
methods.description: Private static method that reads the file line by line, parses points, adds them to XYData, and logs the min/max X and Y values.
